title: Translate the corpus Datasheet/summary (domain reviewer)
context: Translating the corpus Datasheet/summary widens reuse, but oncology terminology must be faithful and no medical advice may be introduced. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The target language is chosen together with a named language reviewer (not fabricated), and a domain (oncology) reviewer verifies terminology. The Datasheet is our own CC-BY-4.0 content, so the translation stays CC-BY-4.0; per-article licenses are unaffected.
objective: Produce a faithful translation of the corpus Datasheet/summary, verified by a language reviewer and a domain (oncology) reviewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Translation of the corpus Datasheet/summary produced for a target language confirmed with a named language reviewer (language not fabricated; selected with the reviewer).
Domain (oncology) reviewer verifies that medical/scientific terminology is faithfully translated and no medical advice is introduced.
Translation preserves the source Datasheet's CC-BY-4.0 license and attribution; per-article licenses are unaffected.
